title: DOJ moves to recover USDC tied to Binance hack
summary: The Block reports the Justice Department is seeking to recover about $1.17 billion in USDC tied to the Binance hack. DefiLlama lists Binance's October 29 loss at $6,360,000,000. Chainalysis puts it at $6.4 billion.
